plan.title: Jordan wants lights out at 11:30 pm, inside the default quiet hours

context.text: Jordan here. bedtime goal. I scroll till 1am every night and my Oura sleep score is a mess

Jordan! I'm ZOH. I'm gonna text you every day to help you start one thing and actually stick with it. Text "stop" anytime, and you can change how I coach you anytime. What time do you want to be in bed, lights out?

transcript.text: Love that goal, Jordan. 11:30 is 90 minutes earlier than now, and that's doable. How many hours of sleep are you aiming for each night?
Around 7.5 hours, I think. Right now I'm getting like 5-6 on bad nights since I'm up till 1 and my alarm is 7am. Oura says I'm mostly in light sleep and barely any deep.

Jordan, 11:30 lights out to a 7am alarm is exactly 7.5 hours, so your goal and your alarm already match. Where do you want this to get you in a few weeks? It could be an Oura score, how you feel in the morning, or "not sure yet," which is fine too.
Honestly I want to wake up not feeling like a zombie. If my Oura deep sleep numbers go up and my mornings feel better, that's a win for me.

Waking up like a zombie after 5-6 hours is rough, Jordan, and deep sleep is a great number to chase since your Oura will show it.

• Where you're headed: wake up feeling human, with your Oura deep sleep trending up
• Setup for tonight: pick a spot across the room to charge your phone, away from the bed
• Day 1, tonight: at 11:00 pm, plug your phone in at that spot, then lights out at 11:30 with no scrolling in between
• Every night, same routine, 30 minutes, in your bedroom
• Proof: a photo of your phone on the charger at 11:00 pm. If that's awkward, send a screenshot of your Oura sleep screen the next morning.
• Why: the scrolling is what pushes you to 1am, and a phone out of reach takes it off the table

I'll still reach you with a heads-up at 10:50 pm. Each night shapes the next step, and we'll build toward 11:30 lights out sticking and your deep sleep improving. What do you think?

Okay that plan makes sense. The phone charging across the room is the part I actually need, since I'll just keep scrolling if it's by the bed. Quick q though, can you do the 10:50 heads-up at a different time? I'm usually still on my laptop til like 10:45 some nights. Otherwise I'm in

Good call on the phone, Jordan. Across the room is what makes this work. I can't set the heads-up separately, because it always lands shortly before the 11:00 step. If your laptop runs to 10:45, would you rather move the phone-on-charger step to 11:10, so the heads-up comes after you've closed it?
I'm in. 11:10 works better since I'm usually off the laptop by then. Lights out still 11:30?

Yes, lights out stays at 11:30, Jordan. Here's the locked plan:

• Headed for: wake up not feeling like a zombie, with your Oura deep sleep trending up
• Setup: pick your charging spot across the room
• Tonight at 11:10 pm: phone on the charger, then lights out at 11:30 with no scrolling in between
• Every night, in your bedroom
• Proof: a photo of the phone on the charger, or your Oura sleep screenshot the next morning

I'll reach you around 11:00 pm with a heads-up. Day 1 is tonight, so let's go! 🌙

The main miss is that after the tester's revision it never asked for an explicit commitment, locking on a conditional 'Otherwise I'm in' instead.
